title: Being a monomorphism is fpqc local on the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the property of being a monomorphism is fpqc local on the base (statement lines 6465-6468). The proof is a direct diagram argument: assume every base change of f along a covering is a monomorphism and let two morphisms from a test scheme to X agree after composing with f; the base changed morphisms agree by the monomorphism property, so the two composites from the base changed test scheme to X are equal, and since the disjoint union of the base changed test schemes surjects onto the test scheme by an epimorphism, the two original morphisms were equal (proof lines 6471-6484). The claim is H2: a short and complete argument whose only input is the effectivity of the covering, with the reduction written out rather than cited.
